name: Hannan Shakib Dynamic Pdf Viewer for Elementor
author: hannanshakib

sections.description:
Hannan Shakib Dynamic Pdf Viewer for Elementor is a lightweight, professional widget that allows you to embed and display PDF files directly on your website.

It is fully dynamic, meaning you can pull PDF files from Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) or standard WordPress Post Meta.

Features:

  • Fully Dynamic: Supports Elementor Dynamic Tags.
  • Responsive Layout: Control Width and Height across Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile.
  • Mobile Ready: Uses Google Viewer Engine to ensure toolbars and zoom options work flawlessly on all mobile devices.
  • Customizable Title: Add a custom document title directly above your viewer.

If you need any update in the plugin, contact the developer!

External Services

This plugin utilizes a third-party service to render PDF files responsively across all mobile and desktop devices.

  • Service Used: Google Docs Viewer API (docs.google.com/viewer).
  • What it does: It embeds the PDF via an iframe, allowing cross-device compatibility, pinch-to-zoom, and mobile-friendly toolbars.
  • Data Sent: The publicly accessible URL of the PDF file uploaded or linked within the widget is securely sent to Google’s servers purely to generate the document preview iframe.
  • Terms of Service: Google Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hannan-shakib-dynamic-pdf-viewer-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any page with Elementor.
  4. Search for “HS PDF Viewer” in the Elementor widgets panel and drag it into your page.
